note: Verified on a 2018 Pacifica Hybrid with WiCAN PRO 4.51 and 6.0.0-beta.7. Energy-counter reset/rollover behavior is unverified.
comment: Hybrid-specific battery readings; other model years and the gasoline-only Pacifica have not been tested. Energy expressions decode the observed 16-bit counter words at 0.1 kWh/count. The existing generic 015B signal is retained without claiming dashboard SOC scaling.
